interpretation: measurements of one non-primary fixture on this laptop VM; not corpus throughput and not a host qualification

harness_defect_rule: If the run fails before writing a report because of a harness defect (not a measured limit or native failure), at most one re-run is allowed under a new marker execute-2.json with identical plan, fixture and limits; the defect, fix and both runs are disclosed. This infrastructure measurement produces no scientific outcome, so a re-run cannot select a favourable result.
